assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 41-46: '### Environment / Version' section contains '> Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' and the analysis notes 'The Environment / Version section is present but contains only vague text with no extractable version identifier.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md lines 9-33: Section 4.5.2 scans the Environment / Version text for explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, version keywords, and build identifiers -- all return 'No'. Line 30 states: 'No version pattern can be extracted from the Environment / Version section. The text is classified as vague/indeterminate.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md lines 49-56: Section 4.5.6 outputs the gap comment: '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' The text matches the required gap comment (double-hyphen is the markdown-safe equivalent of an em dash).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
